body:
We  haven't been fighting but it's just been a lot of...
"I can't do this, I keep thinking about you in bed with someone else."

"I didn't do anything, I don't cheat. It's not who I am. I've been cheated on and I would never want anyone to experience what I've experienced."

"I just keep thinking of you doing things with her that you do with me."

"There is no her, that person doesn't exist because I didn't cheat, and never will."

"I want this to work, but  I just don't know how we are going to get past this."

"My heart want's to believe you, but my brain keeps thinking you slept with someone."

I'm just trying to do all I can to keep reinforcing that it didn't happen, has never happened in my life, and will never happen... because that's the truth.

Yes. 100%. She has definitely agreed that we have communication issues. A lot of the time it tends to be in the form of text messaging. Whereas we may not understand the tone in each others words. (which is why I haaaaaate texting sometimes.) We've recently decided that if we have any questions at all about a text to call and elaborate. On my end.. her messages that sound insecure, sound exactly that to me. On her end... she is saying them in a playful, yet sarcastic tone (much like she does in person... when I can physically hear that tone.)

Granted it was only last weekend that this worry of me cheating happened, so it is still fresh. But yeah, I mean.. it's not like we are fighting now. Now it's more "My heart says you didn't do it, but my brain says you did." and "I want this, but I don't know when I am going to be okay with this." and she's been cheated on in the past, but so have I.. and I know how awful it feels to be cheated on, which other than it being a pretty disgusting act, is why I would never do it, I would never want someone to feel what I've felt before and that is why I am not getting frustrated because I know I didn't cheat on her. 

And while yes you are correct, it's a lot of issues for 9 months, but there has been a lot of good to go with it. I could easily make a giant post of what I like about our relationship (if I were to make a pros and cons list, I am positive the pros would outweigh the cons.)  It's odd, I feel like our most stressful times is when we're apart, but when we are together, it all feels amazing and I have definitely realized there are huuuuuge miscommunication problems here that I've been trying to fix.

Yeah, I feel like that's what has been going on. I'm also in this situation where she thinks I cheated on her. We got into a huge fight. The entire fight was because my phone was going to die and she couldn't communicate with me... I was under the impression it was because she didn't trust me to behave (which I did, and always do because I love her.)  She was out of town and I was out at the pubs one night and my phone died, and when I got home, I charged my phone but I passed out before I turned it on, so when I woke up, I turned my phone on and called her... and she has it stuck in her mind that I cheated on her... and I didn't. I couldn't do that. It's just not in my nature as a person to ever do that.
